# AI Chat Backup: ChatGPT to Notion, Obsidian & Markdown

> AI Chat Backup is a Chrome extension for exporting AI conversations as Markdown, writing them directly to local folders such as Obsidian vaults, or syncing them to Notion.

This site is the public documentation and support hub for AI Chat Backup. The extension itself is distributed through the Chrome Web Store; its source code is not included in this documentation repository. Local Markdown export does not require a Notion account. Conversation content is sent to Notion when the user chooses a sync action.

Supported AI platforms documented by the project are ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Studio, Perplexity, Poe, and Grok. Platform interface changes may temporarily affect conversation extraction.

## Product

- [AI Chat Backup: ChatGPT to Notion, Obsidian & Markdown](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/): Product overview, supported platforms, export destinations, and common questions
- [Install AI Chat Backup](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-ai-chat-backup-ma/oedpeddiacomhhfieanenlmdghkolgng): Official Chrome Web Store listing

## ChatGPT Export Guides

- [Export ChatGPT to Notion](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/chatgpt-to-notion/): Authorize the AI Chats template and sync the current conversation
- [Export ChatGPT to Markdown](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/chatgpt-to-markdown/): Create portable files with useful structure and optional YAML metadata
- [Save ChatGPT to Obsidian](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/chatgpt-to-obsidian/): Write Markdown exports into a user-selected Obsidian vault folder
- [Batch Sync ChatGPT Conversations](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/bulk-export-chatgpt/): Sync up to five latest or selected ChatGPT conversations to Notion per free batch

## Other AI Platform Guides

- [Export Claude to Notion](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/claude-to-notion/): Save long-form Claude conversations to Notion or Markdown
- [Save Claude to Obsidian](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/claude-to-obsidian/): Export Claude conversations and code artifacts to an Obsidian vault
- [Export Gemini to Notion](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/gemini-to-notion/): Save Gemini conversations to Notion, Markdown, or Obsidian
- [Save Gemini to Obsidian](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/gemini-to-obsidian/): Save Gemini responses and logical structures to Obsidian
- [Export Perplexity to Notion](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/perplexity-to-notion/): Sync Perplexity search threads, citations, and answers to Notion
- [Save Perplexity to Obsidian](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/perplexity-to-obsidian/): Export Perplexity threads directly to a local Obsidian vault

## Support and Policies

- [Notion Integration Reauthorization Guide](https://chatgpt-to-notion.linkcanvas.space/notion-reauthorization-guide/): Troubleshoot and fix Notion sync connection errors and database configuration issues
- [Documentation Repository](https://github.com/lnmput/chatgpt-to-notion): Installation, user guides, Notion setup, troubleshooting, and frequently asked questions
- [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/lnmput/chatgpt-to-notion/issues): Public bug reports and feature requests; private conversations and credentials must not be posted
- [Privacy Policy](https://chrome-extensions-page.vercel.app/ai-chat-backup/privacy): Data handling and privacy information
